metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.5 · 2018 · A Quiet Place
metas.description: A family struggles for survival in a world invaded by blind alien creatures with ultra-sensitive hearing.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.2 · 2020 · A Quiet Place Part II
metas.description: Following the events at home, the Abbott family now face the terrors of the outside world. Forced to venture into the unknown, they realize the creatures that hunt by sound are not the only threats lurking beyond the sand path.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.2 · 2024 · A Quiet Place: Day One
metas.description: A young woman named Sam finds herself trapped in New York City during the early stages of an invasion by alien creatures with ultra-sensitive hearing.
